title: What measure do I use to compare nested models and non nested models in high dimensional survival analysis [D]

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: In high-dimensional survival analysis, how do we fairly compare nested and non-nested models?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current methods like AIC, BIC, and cross-validation struggle with non-nested models in high dimensions.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Overreliance on these metrics may prioritize accuracy over interpretability and ethical transparency.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are using Bayesian model averaging and double machine learning to better handle complexity.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If we embrace these methods, we could achieve models that are both accurate and ethically sound.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future lies in balancing technical rigor with ethical responsibility in survival modeling.
